title: I2C 主机多字节 FIFO 读写（轮询）
description: I2C Controller writes and reads multiple bytes to/from a target device. The example uses FIFO and polling. It can only handle a maximum of 8 bytes due to FIFO size. LED toggles if transmission and reception are successful. The Target device must be enabled and active before running this example.（SDK 例程：i2c_controller_rw_multibyte_fifo_poll）
